turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are you holding up?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My eyes feel tired after an evening on my phone. Is the brightness doing that?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Partly, yes. Turn on auto-brightness so it dims in dark rooms, and try the night light or warm screen setting after sunset.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The warm one makes everything look yellow. It's kind of gross.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: You can adjust how warm it gets. Even a gentle shift helps, it doesn't have to look like an old photo.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I'll set it to halfway. Anything else?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Every twenty minutes or so, look at something far away for a bit. And hold the phone a little further from your face than feels natural.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: two inches from my nose, honestly.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then that alone could make a big difference.
